Name: CatNap Plushie
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
[quote][color=#d9d2e9]CatNap is a calming presence for the critters and ensures he and his friends always have the right amount of sleep to jumpstart the morning's play! End of the day, there's nothing CatNap enjoys more than watching his friends sleep soundly.[/color][/quote]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=3][b][i]Featuring...[/i][/b][/size][/color]
🌙 The one and only [color=#d9d2e9][b]CatNap[/b][/color]! Get him from the Traveling Cart for 333g or from the Furniture Catalogue [size=1](or just use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url], CatNap won't judge you)[/size]
🌙 He's a new piece of furniture, so he won't replace anything. He just wants to meet all your friends and help them sleep too!
🌙 i18n compatible! Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
🌙 Peak self indulgence and ADHD hyperfixation with absolutely 0 regrets[line]
